[[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] '''Donko Jen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]] who was present at the [[Mensix Mining Facility/Legends|Mensix Mining Facility]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. He was one of the foremen of the facility, along with [[Chivos]], and was a member of the taller, thinner [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of the Mustafarians.

In 1 ABY, Donko Jen was under employ by the Mensix Mining Company as foreman of the Mensix Mining Facility on Mustafar. During his tenure in this year, he hired a traveling [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to destroy some [[Kubaza beetle/Legends|kubaza beetle]] nests that had sprung up at a mining camp in an area of the planet known as The Burning Plains. He provided the spacer with a few explosive charges to hasten the job.

The spacer arrived at the camp to find it absolutely infested with the resilient beetle. He set to work immediately, planting the charges and blowing the nests sky high. This raised the ire of the beetles and they immediately attacked, but the spacer expertly [[Death/Legends|killed]] every last one of them, ending the camps infestation once and for all. Returning to Donko, he was rewarded with 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and a mounted kubaza beetle head as a trophy.

==Behind the scenes==
Donko Jen was a non-playable character in the massively-multiplayer online roleplaying game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. He, along with the planet Mustafar, were added to the game in November of [[2005]] in the expansion pack ''Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan''.
